title: Bloomberg This Weekend | Trump Calls Iran “Small Potatoes”, US Envoys in Russia
description:
The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Nashville Public Radio Senior Reporter & Producer Meribah Knight, Wall Street Journal National Security Reporter Vera Bergengruen, Seaport Research Managing Director & Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub, EU Ambassador to the US Jovita Neliupšienė and The Atlantic Staff Writer and “The Time Tax” Author Annie Lowrey.
